description: This file defines the SuiteValidator class within the SuiteCRM\'Utility\' namespace. It provides methods for validating IDs, keys, and identifying percentage fields, with patterns influenced by global configuration settings.

classes.name: SuiteValidator
classes.description: A utility class for validating IDs, keys, and percentage fields within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: isValidId
methods.description: Validates whether a given ID is valid based on pattern and numeric check.

methods.name: isValidKey
methods.description: Validates whether a given key is valid based on pattern and numeric check.

methods.name: isPercentageField
methods.description: Determines if a field name indicates a percentage or VAT field.

methods.name: getIdValidationPattern
methods.description: Retrieves the ID validation regex pattern, influenced by global configuration.

methods.name: getKeyValidationPattern
methods.description: Retrieves the key validation regex pattern, influenced by global configuration.
